parameters.prompt: A 9-cel hand-drawn silent 'For you!' flower-shop sticker. One chibi florist, Mingqian Nailü, recognizable warm taupe low twin tails with a broad chartreuse bang streak, tiny heart-shaped cowlick, fixed white flower clipped at each temple, white-and-pale-green debut dress. Warm olive eyes. She is wrapping a single bouquet of THREE pale ivory lilies with warm gold throats and long green leaves in a wide blush pink paper cone and a single pink ribbon. Same bouquet throughout, never sprout another, her hair flowers stay on head. Fixed frontal mid shot with an opaque pure WHITE background, strong dark ink, subtle cel shading, high quality hand-painted chibi sticker. The gag is that what looks like an anonymous flower parcel is suddenly a gift for YOU. 1 The large bouquet is very close and hides her FULL FACE. Only the bouquet and TWO hands pinching its wrapping at the sides, face completely occluded. 2 Low hands fold the pink wrapping. 3 Right hand tightens the one ribbon, left hand supports the cone; still a parcel with a hint of hair. 4 She draws parcel back and peeks around the upper LEFT edge of paper, revealing eyes, looks directly at viewer. 5 With bouquet now at chest, tilt head and smile warmly at viewer. 6 Push the same bouquet out toward us, both arms extending in one big generous offering gesture. 7 The lilies approach and cover lower face. 8 Now only her eyes over the advancing flowers, jacket sleeves still visible. 9 Bouquet in tight foreground completely covering her face and both hands at wrapping, visually same as first frame. Deliberately clear changes of entire pose; no animation smear, no rubber limbs, no changing camera, no motion lines, hearts or lettering. At small chat size, wrapping -> peek -> offering toward viewer should be unmistakable. Outer margins white.
